main.description: Notify that a repo in a space has been updated. Sent by repo hosts to the space host, which forwards it to registered syncing services. Requires service auth.

repoRev.description: The repo revision after the write.

data.description: The repo's commit data after the write.

spaceRev.description: The space revision assigned by the space host. Only set on notifications forwarded to syncing services.

prevSpaceRev.description: The previous space revision. Omitted on the first update in a space. A gap indicates missed notifications, which can be recovered with listRepos.

errors.name: FutureRev
errors.description: The repo revision is too far in the future.
